profile.visual_desc: Human male with long brown hair, wearing a blue cape and tunic with gold accents. Mounted on a brown warhorse with blue barding and a dark mane.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Determined male face with sharp eyes and long brown hair. Features a serious expression and a small scar on the forehead above blue attire.
profile.weapon_desc: Long silver spear held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view; paladin sits upright on the horse with the spear held diagonally across the torso.
profile.step2_windup: Rider leans back and raises the spear over the shoulder, preparing a forward thrusting motion.
profile.step3_impact: Spear lunges forward-left; a horizontal golden energy streak appears at the tip, pointing toward the upper-left corner.
profile.step4_finish: Rider retracts the spear and returns to a seated position as the golden light trail dissipates.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy streak in Frame 4 must align exactly with the spear tip and its linear forward-thrust trajectory.

evaluation.diagnosis: Mechanical consistency and wind-up direction are accurate. VFX timing deviates, appearing at F5 instead of F4.
